summary: Per-axis weighted interpolation on float2-like points. For each of the first two components it computes out = (b - a) * a5 + (c - a) * a6 + a, where a = a2, b = a3, c = a4 are the source corners, a5/a6 are the two interpolation weights, and a1 is the destination. Returns a1 unchanged.

local_names.a1: destination float2 (output, also the return value)

operations.description: Write component 0 of the destination: a1[0] = (a3[0] - a2[0]) * a5 + (a4[0] - a2[0]) * a6 + a2[0].
Write component 1 of the destination: a1[1] = (a3[1] - a2[1]) * a5 + (a4[1] - a2[1]) * a6 + a2[1].

out[1] = (cornerB[1] - cornerA[1]) * wB + (cornerC[1] - cornerA[1]) * wC + cornerA[1];
